description:
A truly stunning 4 bedroom detached block built residence situated on a rectangular shaped site with full privacy, this property has been completed to impressively high standards throughout and has a floor area that extends to c. 227 sq.m (c.2,450 sq.ft).  Providing generously proportioned areas throughout, this family home has some spectacular features from its wood and tiled flooring finishes, open plan kitchen/dining, fully landscaped gardens with dining areas, large block built garage  & a fully secured perimeter.  This is a quality home in a prime family location within easy access of Drogheda Town Centre and the M1 Motorway, both within a 10 minute drive. No expense has been spared and this property has been tastefully built with marvellous attention to detail. Viewing Is Highly Recommended.
